skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of marketing tools in approaching international markets.
Collect and analyze factors in the international business environment, select target markets.
Analyze and choose appropriate market entry strategies.
Apply knowledge and mixed marketing tools to develop marketing strategies.
Practically find, exploit, synthesize, analyze, and evaluate data and information in international trade.
Enhance group discussion and decision-making skills.
Increase autonomy, curiosity, and proactive creativity in learning.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve problems in international markets.
